text: Kublai Khan, is he on your way too? I serve Nogai. Only the Doctor can make that work. Nogai's sorcerers will reveal its secrets. Now, enough of this game.

Disarm them. Stop it. You fool, I did not command his death. My name is Tagana, the Warlord. Get rid of these men. I am Ling Tao, Captain and Courier in the Great Khan Service. They were trying to steal the Khan's property. That's not true. I remember both of you. With Messer Marcus Polo's caravan. He is the thief. We caught him with that. Pardon me, my lady. I am not the authority to judge in this dispute.

It's a matter for the Great Khan. And take us to Shang Tu. The Great Khan has left the Summer Palace at Shang Tu, my lord. You will see him in Peking. My gang, you are too good for us at backgammon. Tea, please. Oh, that is our reckoning. Yes, it is, sir. Yes, what do we owe?
Thirty-five elephants with ceremonial bridles, trappings, brocades and pavilions. Four thousand white stallions and twenty-five tigers.
That's not too bad, so far. And the sacred tooth of Buddha, which Polo brought home from India. Oh, that. What else? What more?
Well, I am very much afraid all the commerce from Burma. One year, sir.
Oh, the ambush. Winning, my love. One wins, one loses, my dear. The Great Khan is far too modest, my lady. You are not wagering, are you? You know how it affects your gown.
Oh, how charming. Charming, indeed. And yet, there are moments, old friend, when we wish our character were more like that of our lamented grandfather, Genghis. Did you hear of him?
Genghis Khan? No, I didn't meet him. But I have heard of him, yes. Oh, he was the warrior of the family. Nothing frightened him. We are the planner, the statistician, the administrator.

Oh, she will be furious with me when she finds out what I have lost. Oh, then you've lost nothing, sir. No, no, no. These are debts of honor. Well, one more game, then, and if you win, you can take it all back again. And if you win?
Well, Marco Polo has taken away my caravan and given it to you, sir. If I win, perhaps I could have my caravan back again. No, not that. No, take something else. The island of Sumat.
No, we can't give you Marco's gift. We haven't even seen it yet. But none of this is important to me, sir. You see, win or lose, you can have it all back again. If I win, my TARDIS comes back to me.
Let's play at that stake. Yes, yes. Oh, go away. It's Marco Polo, my lord. Oh, Marco Polo. Would you object to one interruption? No, no, no.
Enter!

Please, for that, Marco, be brief. Please, be brief. As my lord commands, the warlord Tagana has arrived in Peking. When he reaches the palace, shall I bring him directly to you? No, no, we grant him an audience as soon as possible. Oh, we want to tell you something, Marco. We owe half of Asia to our friend at Back Gamble. It is unusual for you to lose, my lord.
Oh, it is a fortune, Marco. But our friend here made a truly...

royal gesture, which we have accepted, though it might upset you. Why should it do that? That's our last game. Our losses against your gift. The caravan? Yes, Marco, we are playing for the TARDIS. But, my lord... Well? Nothing, my lord. I will leave you to your game.
My throw! Yes, your throw.

You will not believe this, but I swear it's true. They're playing Back Gamble for your caravan. What? If the doctor wins, he has won back TARDIS. And if he loses? He's lost everything. Oh, grandfather will win. I hope. Sly old fox. The Khan hasn't even seen it yet, and he's taking it away from him. But this will solve everything. You've made your gesture and given the TARDIS to the Khan, so he should let you go home. And with any luck, we can go home, too. So we'll all have to go home.

We'll have what we wanted. Yes, all except Ping Chiu. Yes, I'm afraid there's nothing we can do about her, Susan. Her future husband is already in Peking. What, in the palace? Yes, there is to be a banquet tonight in his honour, at which 6,000 guests will attend. 6,000? He's a very important man. Well, he must be. When is the wedding? Tomorrow morning. To Ping Chiu. My lord Polo? Yes? Oh, you're the courier that brought me the message from Shantou, aren't you? I am, my lord. It's a pleasure to see you again.

My lord, I fear not. Why? What is wrong? Two members of your party, the lord known as Ian and the lady Ping Chiu, are being held under guard. Why? They're accused of stealing the Khan's property. The TARDIS? Well, who accuses them? Tagana. Yes, my lady. That man is... Well, the grandfather's going to win back the TARDIS, so no charges can be brought. Susan, you don't take your prize until you win the game. Grandfather, you're not lost. He gave me this, the consolation prize.

A piece of his paper currency. Oh, grandfather! You have told me all? Everything, from the moment I found Ping Chiu. And you distinctly heard Tagana say that the Khan was his enemy? Yes. Tagana said, I serve Nogai, and he will conquer the world. Ping Chiu heard it as well. Distinctly, Mr. Marco.

Ning Tao, did you hear this? No, my lord, I did not. That's a pity. You mean our word isn't strong enough against Tagana's? There are two of us, Mr. Marco. No, Ping Chiu, Ian must stand trial alone. Why? Your husband-to-be has asked the Khan to excuse you. He promises to take you away from Peking as soon as the marriage ceremony is over. And the Khan has agreed?
You are to be married tomorrow morning. Thank you for recovering it for us, Lord Tagana. Good fortune gave me the opportunity of serving the great Khan.

Well, lady, Ping Chiu has been excused her complicity in the theft. The Khan shows much wisdom and compassion. What crimes she committed were done under the influence of others. Crimes? Who else was there?
The old man.

The old magician, my lord, tried several times to regain the caravan. Were there other attempts to steal it? Marco did not mention them to us. Is that not natural, my lord, that he would wish to guard them? He always serves us well. In dealings with Mongols like ourselves, yes, my lord, but he is as they are. And does not one's loyalty first lie with one's own kind?
Your point is taken.
Lord Tagana.
Marco! Thank you for our gift.
I am the Khan's obedient servant.
We are glad to know. But when there were other attempts to steal the caravan, why did you not invoke our laws?
To have done so would have been unjust, my lord. Our laws are alien to them.
They were on our soil, therefore subject to our laws. Why did you not invoke them?
The caravan belonged to them, my lord.
My lord, I can hold my peace no longer. Forgive me. How can that be? You claimed it in the Khan's name.
It was wrong of me to do so.
You wear the Khan's gold seal. That gives you your authority to take what you will.
When the cause is just, this was not.
What was it then?
Selfish.
What did you hope to gain?
He wanted to force you to let him return to Venice.
He wanted to bribe us, Marco.
Marco!
Marco!
Marco!
Marco!
Marco!
Marco!
He wanted to force me to return home, my lord.
Your gift has failed. It is ours because he won the right to keep it in the game of chance.
Where is the key?
In my quarters, my lord.
Bring it to us after the banquet, and then we'll examine our prize.
My lord, you do me a great wrong.
We are distressed and angered by your conduct, Marco. We think about it.
You also attend us after the banquet, Lord Tigana.
We'll discuss the terms of our settlement with Nogai.
But we'll be on guard against you.
What have I that the Khan should fear?
The power of persuasion.
The festival of the feast!
How shall we tell her?
I'll be...
Carrie Brantford!
Oh, here you are, my child!
Come, we have something to tell you.
A tragedy has occurred at the table tonight.
Tragedy, my lord?
Your beloved husband, to be so anxious to be worthy of your love, drank a potion of quicksilver and sulphur, the elixir of life and eternal youth, and expired on the spirit.
Come into my arms, child.
Let me share your grief.
You're overdoing it.
My dear child is dry-eyed.
Ungrateful wretch!
Do you not weep for your lost love?
My lady, I grieve an old man's death as all would do, but how can I weep for a love I have never known?
Tell us, Pingchou, do you wish to return to your home in Samarkand, or would you like to stay a while in our court and brighten all our days?
If I may, my lord.
I would like to stay.
So be it.
Wait, Marco.
Tell us, my child, your opinion of the travellers from a distant land.
They are my friends, my lord, as they will always be.
Thank you, Pingchou.
Wait, Marco.
Let that young officer escort Lady Pingchou to her quarters.
She is forthright and honest.
We trust her, as we once did you.
Our mind dwelt upon your conduct, Marco, and we decided that you have to prove yourself worthy of our trust.
If you fail this to do, we take from you our patronage, banish you from our court, and let your enemies fall upon you.
You have the key of the caravan?
Yes, my lord.
But you would be well advised to have the doctor with you when you open it.
Catch him, Marco!
Catch him!
No!
Wait!
Not until our audience with the Lord Tegana is concluded.
I underestimated you, Tegana.
You overestimated yourself.
It's Tegana's game.
Well, we can be quite clear about that.
Tegana said, I serve Nogai, and he will conquer the world with the help of the Togai.
I always knew Tegana was a two-faced villain.
Yes, well, that doesn't help Ian, does it?
He's got to take the blame.
I wish I could remember what it was the Khan said that upset Marco so much.
What's it matter now?
Well, it was something about Nogai and Tegana.
I'm sure Tegana was behind that banditry, but why?
It wasn't just my ship then.
Whatever double game Tegana is playing, he must have decided upon a long time before we appeared on the scene.
I remember.
Hm?
The Khan was furious because Nogai had moved his armies from Samarkand to Karakoram.
And that's why he delayed Marco Polo's caravan, to give Nogai more time to move his armies nearer Peking.
Yes, that makes sense.
Even so, why should Kublai Khan fear Nogai?
He has an enormous army, and he's already defeated him once, surely.
Yes, but what you have to take into account where battles are concerned, dear boy, are its leaders.
Kill the leader, and where are you? What happens?
The whole army dissipates.
The whole army dissipates itself into chaos and utter confusion.
It happens throughout your history time and time again.
Grandfather, do you mean to say Tegana is going to assassinate the Khan?
Exactly.
And what could be a better answer than to disorganize everything here?
It gives Nogai the perfect answer to overrun the country.
But then we must get to the Khan before Tegana kills him otherwise.
I've had it.
Yes, we've all had it.
Look, how are we going to get him past the guard?
Open the door.
Let's try down here.
What are you doing, you fool?
Tegana, he's going to kill the Khan.
Marco, listen to me.
Tegana.
Take him back to his cell and keep him under close surveillance.
Marco, you can't do this.
What is it?
The messenger's just arrived.
Nogai's army is marching on Peking.
Tegana's in the throne room with the Khan now.
Look, somebody must protect him.
Hold that, Doctor, and stay here all of you.
Your terms of peace are hard, my lord.
Tegana.
Those who rise against us.
Must be humbled.
They shall be honored.
I promise Nogai to make an end of this matter.
Those who rise against us.
Will be humbled.
You must die.
Take him away.
Doctor, take the keys, quickly.
Thank you.
Now go.
Thank you.
Come along.
Goodbye.
Goodbye, Pinchot.
Your caravan.
Quickly.
Goodbye.
I am sorry, my lord.
I am sorry.
I had to give them back their flying caravan.
If you hadn't, the old man would have worn it, that back garment.
And it is true.
A flying caravan.
There's something for you to tell your friends in Venice.
No, my lord.
They would not believe half the things that I have seen in Cathay.
But what is the truth?
I wonder where they are now.
